positions.title: Student Developer
positions.description: 360 Website Project Management Team - Maintained the 360 student portal (360.gordon.edu) of the College by fixing and reporting bugs and reviewing codes of peers. The team had weekly meetings to share progress, ideas, and ask questions.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
+ Project ApartApp. Developed backend portion of an online housing (apartment) application form using C#, SQL, and python, in a team of four, for the Housing Department of Gordon College.
+ The form was an improvement from an excel spreadsheet that the students had to fill in and email back. It reduced the significant work hours of the housing director by automating the point calculations used for the housing lottery, and have an option to export submitted applications to a CSV file.
+ The form was built upon the existing website of the college.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description: Provided technical support to troubleshoot computer/network related issues in person, over the phone, and/or email. Assisted software setup, computer hardware installation, and password reset. Answered operator calls.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
+ Worked on Python picture & sound library and GUI development to replace a long-outdated education-purpose IDE used for Introduction to Programming class of Computer Science department
+ Took a leading role in developing the GUI portion of the program. The resulted program, JES4py, is a cross-platform, importable (pip installable) python package. It replaced the Jython-based IDE that stopped working on the newer Macintosh OS (Catalina).

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Republic of Korea (South Korea) government project.
+ Cross-border preliminary research for developing new construction fire safety laws and systems in South Korea, as part of a long-term project for the advancement and assurance of construction material quality.
+ Wrote detailed reports about fire standards, U.S. state laws of construction safety, contractor license laws, insurance laws, U.S. construction material/product market, historical examples/cases, and other related subjects.
+ Collaborated with Architecture & Urban Research Institute (AURI).
